status: Frozen before independent numeric covariance/score inspection; exploratory algebra validation only
cohort: all 42 final native iteration-3 states and preceding iteration-1/2 states in one existing log
row_rule: require exact same accepted epoch IDs, bands, MJD and data/errors across iterations 2 and 3; preserve/report failures without dropping objects
covariance_rule: C2=inverse exported W2, C3=inverse exported W3; E=diag(JEP_DATAFLUX_ERR^2+JEP_FUDGEFLUX_ERR^2)+COVFUDGE_DATA. Active NML FUDGE_MAG_COVERR blank and later-iteration fudge maxima zero imply E=diag(exported DATAFLUX_ERR^2) for this run. Source snlc_fit.car 10172-10223,10500-10521,14582-14597. M2=C2-E; predicted C3=E+10^(-0.8*(D2-D1))*M2 using previous fit amplitudes. Native float32 per-epoch model terms can leave small residual. No PSD clipping.
score_rule: At final iteration 3, W3 is covariance anchored at prior fit D2 while f3 and r3 use reported final D3. k=0.4 ln(10); f_D=-k*f3; C_D=-2k*(C3-E). Report -2*f_D^T W3 r3, -r3^T W3 C_D W3 r3, and tr(W3 C_D), their sum, plus frozen-C term separately. No alternate D optimization.
eigen_rule: Report eigenvalues of E^(-1/2)(C2-E)E^(-1/2) and absolute/model normalized scales; no PSD enforcement
interpretation: These scores are local Gaussian expression diagnostics, not the native optimizer objective or a physical noise correction; native source excludes logdet in data FITCHI2.
